string.text: All right, what do you need?
Are you the technician here?
Name's Nitro. I am the technician here. The others left, but I did not abandon my workshop.
Can you repair my gear?
Weapons, armor, and helmets — no problem. I can repair modified gear too.
Can you install upgrades?
No. I do not install standard upgrades anymore. I only build and sell ready-made module kits from spare parts; you install those yourself.
I have a locked PDA here. Think you can unlock it?
Trying to recover useful intel or intimate snork photos? Do not scowl at me, I am not judging. That is how the Zone works: what you find is yours.
I just need the information.
Sure, I can do it. Easy work. But I am telling you now: payment up front.
Got it, thanks.
I found a locked PDA. Here is what I have.
Show me. Which one do you want unlocked?
Novice PDA (400 RU).
Stalker PDA (2,500 RU).
Veteran PDA (8,000 RU).
Master PDA (12,000 RU).
Done. Take it — the lock is gone.
You do not have enough money. I told you: payment up front.
No luck. You keep the locked PDA and your money.
That is all for now. See you.
Which modules can you build today?
I can only make two different modules per day, one of each. I do not keep unsold stock. Here is what remains:
Rough work tools: +20% reliability.
Fine work tools: +10% damage.
Soft work tools: −20% recoil.
Calibration tools: +15% accuracy.
Magazine file: +10 capacity.
Attachment kit: −50% weapon weight.
2,000 RU, four weapon parts, and two wire spools. They will all be used up.
3,000 RU, three weapon parts, two transistor sets, and one textolite plate.
2,500 RU, two weapon parts, and two capacitor sets.
4,000 RU, two weapon parts, one capacitor set, and one textolite plate.
5,000 RU, four weapon parts, two wire spools, and one capacitor set.
6,000 RU, five weapon parts, two transistor sets, and two textolite plates.
Build it.
Not enough yet.
Bring the complete recipe. I do not work on credit or from thin air.
Done. This one is yours; I will not make another copy today.
Let me see something else.
Nothing else for today?
That is all for today. Come back tomorrow; a new pair will be ready after a full game day.
All right, see you.
